set.body: PRD C-9, X-2 through X-4. Relation is the inspectable All, SameOn, DifferentOn, And ADT with named projections, not an arbitrary predicate. PairDesign admits BetweenDirected, WithinDirected, and WithinUndirected only; self policy is within-only, per-focal selection is directed-only, and canonical undirected evaluation requires SymmetricCompare. Pairing constructors are facades over these primitives.
set.title: Sealed Relation algebra and legal PairDesign inhabitants
